**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, field-of-use or territory restriction on Bluefly, which is the playbook's preferred position.

- **§ 14.16 Freedom of Action** runs in our favour: "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others."
- Targeted searches for competing-product language, "Customer shall not …", exclusivity, sole-source and minimum-commitment constructs surfaced nothing restraining our business.
- Provisions checked and cleared as non-covenants: **§ 14.11 No Resale** (scope-of-use limit on IBM's own Services, not on what we may buy or build), **§ 12.1 License** (licence scope plus standard reverse-engineering bar), and **§ 14.19 Geographic Scope** (limits IBM's delivery obligations, not our operations).
